o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طَانِشُقْ (danışuq).
By surface analysis, danış- (“to talk”) + -ıq.
From Proto-Turkic *čiŕ- (“to draw”). Compare Turkish çizmek.
Borrowed from Russian страте́гия (stratégija), ultimately from Ancient Greek στρατηγία (stratēgía, “office of general, command, generalship”).
